teacher_authored_rule: Count teacher originals with traceable individual independent human scores and comments. Preserve original version, author type and rater evidence; a self-described Band 9 model is insufficient.
notes: User-approved collection minimum, not a statistical accuracy guarantee. Evaluation goal is a first stratified check, not sufficient for a precise population estimate. Preserve existing lower-band evidence without counting it toward 6-plus quotas.
evaluation_gate: Do not begin until references, diagnostic readings and a complete 28-case packet are ready.
